## GELOS Land Cover {#lc-dataset}

::: {.two-col}
::: {}
[Class separation for global categorical land cover]{.muted}

- [78,535]{.hl} pure land cover chips
- GSD 960 m × 960 m
- Sentinel-1 RTC: 4 scenes / year
- Sentinel-2 L2A: 4 scenes / year\*
- Landsat Collection 2: 4 scenes / year\*
- DEM: 1 annual scene

[\* Cloud-free]{.muted}
:::
